checks.command: ruff check services/evaluation.py services/evaluation_envelope.py services/evaluation_metrics.py tests/test_evaluation.py tests/test_evaluation_envelope.py tests/test_evaluation_metrics.py
ruff format --check services/evaluation.py services/evaluation_envelope.py services/evaluation_metrics.py tests/test_evaluation.py tests/test_evaluation_envelope.py tests/test_evaluation_metrics.py

supported_claims: Evaluation runs carry typed provenance, runtime/hardware context, evidence class, wall time and limitations.
Manifest case identities are counted exactly once; failed and timed-out cases remain in the denominator.
The ASR scorer reports fixed-normalization WER, CER, substitutions, deletions and insertions while preserving the 5% gate.
limitations: Synthetic and software tests do not establish clinical accuracy or independent annotation.
The generic runner captures evaluator exceptions as failed cases without exception details; it is not a model orchestration backend.
